notes: «وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ» takes the whole chain of prev1 (report 426): five inherited links. Its last link is the Imam, who is also the speaker here («قال أبو عبد الله»), so he is not written twice.
The two Muhammad b. al-Ḥasans are two men, each with its own «حدثني» in prev1: not merged (rule 7).
